name: Legends of Seltso
description: The legends of Seltso as Minecraft mobs. Kalabushkin fist-bumps you, drops a carpenter's plane or mallet and leaves a spirit that follows you. Vlad Logutov rides his mountain bike up to you to ask a question and drops the Shatuni, a two-handed crankset you spin like a circular saw. Little Koch tags along with Vlad and drops fat. Vasily shambles around like a zombie, shakes your hand and hands out snus, vapes and cigarettes that leave you weak, sick and tripping. Barsik is a fat, invulnerable cat who hides from everyone and parachutes down from any fall. Alexey Srpava strolls with silent Rita, pays her compliments and drops a phone in a diamond case.
